normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals one or more official ITIS invalid species names whose synonym_links rows resolve to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Mammalia species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Mammalia species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar supplies a frozen, exact nomenclatural crosswalk for the declared COL26.8 Mammalia partition. It is not a final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier, fossil record or scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车仅为声明的 COL26.8 哺乳类分区提供冻结的严格命名交叉映射；它不是最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案、化石记录或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search the non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; a detail request loads exactly one matching immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No ITIS-only current species belong to this package partition.

integration.pagesLight: Pages may retain this descriptor and omit every row-level JSONL gzip shard.
integration.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include this descriptor and every listed row-level shard byte-for-byte.

lookup.requestPolicy: Select the sole file whose inclusive firstColUsageId/lastColUsageId range contains the requested COL usage ID; load and parse only that payload shard.
lookup.forbiddenBehavior: A single-species detail query must not download or parse the complete authority sidecar or more than one payload shard.
